$schema.name: loopr.edge-route-manifest
$schema.description: REF-03 static Edge route inventory. Entries are flat. Code-supported fixture states are separate from pending screenshot evidence.

presentation_vocabulary.root_gate: Selected by the root AppRoute gate; no parent screen is implied.
presentation_vocabulary.persistent_shell: Persistent shell container holding the five tabs.
presentation_vocabulary.tab: Persistent destination in the shell tab order.
presentation_vocabulary.push: Navigator push to a new screen.
presentation_vocabulary.push_replacement: Navigator pushReplacement to a new screen.
presentation_vocabulary.embedded: Rendered inside a parent screen rather than navigated independently.
presentation_vocabulary.developer_push: Navigator push to a source-reachable developer/debug screen; not a production feature route.

entry_fields.parent_route: Flat containing route, or null for root-gate/root destinations.
entry_fields.alternate_entry_points: Other source-proven entry points to this same destination; use instead of duplicate entries.
entry_fields.fixture_state: Default and explicitly source-supported state targets.
entry_fields.appearance_targets: Requested light/dark targets, not runtime evidence.
entry_fields.verification_level: Must be code for this static fallback.
entry_fields.source_citations: Existing Edge file paths and inclusive line ranges.
entry_fields.screenshot_evidence: Addressable state x appearance matrix; every artifact/checksum is null pending REF-03.3.

fixture_state_schema.states: Objects with name, source_supported=true, and exact source citations/evidence. No inferred universal states.

screenshot_evidence_schema.targets: Every target is captured with checksum or explicitly unreproducible with a reason.
screenshot_evidence_schema.artifact: Repository-relative PNG path for captured targets; null for unreproducible targets.
screenshot_evidence_schema.checksum: Lowercase SHA-256 for captured targets; null for unreproducible targets.

manifest_metadata.fallback_reason: Flutter is unavailable in the pinned OpenStrap Code/edge worktree.
manifest_metadata.route_shape: flat entries only; nested sections are forbidden
